LESSON: USES OF WATER

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3.2: Uses of water

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Uses of water. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different uses of water in the home and school
2. demonstrate careful use of water in the home and school
3. appreciate careful use of water in the home and school. a scrapbook on careful use of watereither in the home or at school as part of a personal experience and to bring out the value of careful use of water Core-competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration while working in groups; Digital literacy; Creativity: ability to think critically and creatively in making the scrapbook Links to PCI’s: Personal hygiene

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify different uses of water in the home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify different uses of water in the home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate careful use of water in the home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate careful use of water in the home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate careful use of water in the home and school. a scrapbook on careful use of watereither in the home or at school as part of a personal experience and to bring out the value of careful use of water Core-competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration while working in groups; Digital literacy; Creativity: ability to think critically and creatively in making the scrapbook Links to PCI’s: Personal hygiene
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate careful use of water in the home and school. a scrapbook on careful use of watereither in the home or at school as part of a personal experience and to bring out the value of careful use of water Core-competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration while working in groups; Digital literacy; Creativity: ability to think critically and creatively in making the scrapbook Links to PCI’s: Personal hygiene. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Uses of water.
2. Explain Uses of water to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Uses of water.
4. Show that you can: identify different uses of water in the home and school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Uses of water. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Uses of water important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify different uses of water in the home and school
2. demonstrate careful use of water in the home and school
3. appreciate careful use of water in the home and school. a scrapbook on careful use of watereither in the home or at school as part of a personal experience and to bring out the value of careful use of water Core-competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration while working in groups; Digital literacy; Creativity: ability to think critically and creatively in making the scrapbook Links to PCI’s: Personal hygiene

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
